quickNote.description: Anything you want the Studio to hold — a thought, a line, a fragment. It doesn't need to be finished.
quickNote.example: e.g. Kept choosing rest today instead of pushing through.

foyer-becoming.title: Name a becoming
foyer-becoming.description: A short sentence about who you're growing into — present tense, as if it is already beginning. It can change any time.
foyer-becoming.example: e.g. I'm becoming someone who rests before they're depleted.

foyer-feeling.title: Make room for a feeling
foyer-feeling.prompt: What feeling would you like to make room for?
foyer-feeling.description: A feeling you want more of in ordinary days. One word or a short phrase is plenty.

foyer-principle.title: Name a guiding principle
foyer-principle.description: A value or principle you want to steer by.
foyer-principle.example: e.g. Depth over breadth — a few things, done with care.

uncharted.title: Leave a possibility
uncharted.description: A possibility that doesn't need a plan, an answer, or a reason yet. Begin anywhere.
uncharted.example: e.g. What if I only worked mornings?

vision.title: Add to Vision
vision.prompt: What would an ordinary Tuesday look like if this were true?
vision.description: A picture of the life you're creating in this area — concrete and ordinary, not grand.
vision.example: e.g. Mornings unhurried, one deep-work block, home by six.

identity-values-feelings.title: Add to Identity, values & feelings
identity-values-feelings.prompt: Who is the version of me living this?
identity-values-feelings.description: Who you are being in this area, and what you value here.
identity-values-feelings.example: e.g. Someone who says no without a long explanation.

decisions.title: Add a decision
decisions.prompt: What can I choose in the next 30, 60, or 90 days?
decisions.description: A choice or experiment you can act on soon.
decisions.example: e.g. Try a four-day writing week for a month.

practices.title: Add a practice
practices.prompt: What rhythm lets this be lived repeatedly?
practices.description: A repeatable rhythm that keeps this alive.

structure-strategy.title: Add to Structure & strategy
structure-strategy.prompt: What supports it — time, environment, help, boundary, money, system?
structure-strategy.description: The time, space, help, boundary, or system that holds this up.
structure-strategy.example: e.g. Phone charges outside the bedroom.
